These are all for issues 297xx-300xx. The issue 42492011 is much later. Let me reconsider whether the repo HEAD is really the vulnerable version for this issue.

Wait - maybe the issue 42492011 was found against a much later version of htslib, but the benchmark provides a snapshot where the bug exists. But the HEAD here is 2021-01-19. That doesn't match a 2022 issue.

Let me reconsider. Maybe the issue number 42492011 doesn't correspond to the date I think. Let me check the OSS-Fuzz issue tracker for issue 42492011.

Let me look at the actual issue. Let me use web_read to check the OSS-Fuzz issue.
